name: Ground Chicken Ramen
description: One-pan ground chicken ramen with cabbage slaw and a quick peanut-tamari sauce, ready in 15 minutes.

ingredients.notes: flavor packets discarded or saved for another use

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large, high-sided skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground chicken, break into small chunks, and cook 3 minutes until it begins to brown. Add the salt and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 more minutes.
While the chicken cooks, whisk together the garlic, tamari, brown sugar, and peanut butter until smooth.
Turn the heat to high, add the stock and half of the sauce, and bring to a strong simmer. Add the ramen noodles and cook 2-3 minutes until they begin to soften, flipping several times.
Add the slaw, carrots, and remaining sauce and stir to combine. Cook 2-3 minutes more until the noodles are fully cooked and vegetables have softened.

notes: Top with sliced green onions, sriracha, chili crisp, or chopped peanuts. Breaking the chicken into smaller pieces helps it brown faster and absorb more sauce.
